data.name: sqlInsertCommand1.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO [TBL_student] ([StudID], [StuName], [Class], [Sex], [CreateTime]) VALUES (@StudID, @StuName, @Class, @Sex, @CreateTime); SELECT ID, StudID, StuName, Class, Sex, CreateTime FROM TBL_student WHERE (ID = SCOPE_IDENTITY())

data.name: sqlUpdateCommand1.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE [TBL_student] SET [StudID] = @StudID, [StuName] = @StuName, [Class] = @Class, [Sex] = @Sex, [CreateTime] = @CreateTime WHERE (([ID] = @Original_ID) AND ([StudID] = @Original_StudID) AND ([StuName] = @Original_StuName) AND ((@IsNull_Class = 1 AND [Class] IS NULL) OR ([Class] = @Original_Class)) AND ((@IsNull_Sex = 1 AND [Sex] IS NULL) OR ([Sex] = @Original_Sex)) AND ((@IsNull_CreateTime = 1 AND [CreateTime] IS NULL) OR ([CreateTime] = @Original_CreateTime))); SELECT ID, StudID, StuName, Class, Sex, CreateTime FROM TBL_student WHERE (ID = @ID)

data.name: sqlDeleteCommand1.CommandText
data.value: DELETE FROM [TBL_student] WHERE (([ID] = @Original_ID) AND ([StudID] = @Original_StudID) AND ([StuName] = @Original_StuName) AND ((@IsNull_Class = 1 AND [Class] IS NULL) OR ([Class] = @Original_Class)) AND ((@IsNull_Sex = 1 AND [Sex] IS NULL) OR ([Sex] = @Original_Sex)) AND ((@IsNull_CreateTime = 1 AND [CreateTime] IS NULL) OR ([CreateTime] = @Original_CreateTime)))
